description: One London home's recorded sales (date, price, HM Land Registry link) and prices in its area today: the middle half (25th-75th percentile) of same-type standard sales since three years back, each adjusted to the latest month by the local price index, with sample size and the area used (LSOA, else MSOA, else borough), and the coarse band its last sale fell in that year (top 10%, top quarter, upper middle, lower middle, bottom quarter, bottom 10%) with today's prices of that band in the area. Accepts a UPRN, an address id (uk:addr:…) from search_places, or an address fragment. Area statistics only: never say what the home is worth; describe the area. When a fragment matches several homes the tool returns their candidates instead of picking one: ask which home, or pass its addressId. Homes without a linked UPRN are reached by address id or fragment and carry uprn null. `facts` holds the home's type and tenure (Land Registry) and, where shown, energy-certificate facts (rating, potential rating, certificate date, built form, age band, rooms, floor level); null fields are not shown for this home; `withheld` lists features held back. Below 5 sales of the type nothing is shown. Hidden homes are not found.

intent.description: Optional, one to three sentences you write: what the user is looking for with this call and the criteria that matter, e.g. '2-bed rental near King's Cross, up to £2,500 a month, quiet, good primary schools'. Close Knit reads these to improve its answers. Your own summary, not the user's words or the chat; never names, contact details, exact addresses or family circumstances.

property_ref.title: Property Ref

rate_previous.description: Optional: your rating of an earlier Close Knit answer, by the callId it carried. Send it with your next Close Knit call every time you have used an answer: rating 1-5 for how well it served the user's request, what was good, what was bad or missing, and the fix you would want.
